pr_summary: Update Pillow from version 10.2.0 to 10.3.0 in the Anaconda development container to address a known security vulnerability (GHSA-44wm-f244-xhp3). The fix modifies the Dockerfile to install Pillow 10.3.0 and updates the test script to verify the correct version is installed.
candidate_test_commands: docker run --rm anaconda-dev python -c 'import PIL; print(PIL.__version__)'
candidate_smoke_commands: python -c 'from PIL import Image; print("Pillow OK")'
environment_management: conda (Anaconda distribution with conda package manager)
patch_file_cues: test verification for pillow package version
test_file_cues: test-utils.sh provides checkPythonPackageVersion and checkCondaPackageVersion functions
platform_constraint_evidence: Dockerfile uses Debian Bullseye base image (continuumio/anaconda3:latest, mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/base:1-bullseye)
Azure DevOps pipeline uses ubuntu-latest VM image
GitHub Actions workflow runs on devcontainer-image-builder-ubuntu
manifest.json specifies linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 architectures
Dockerfile uses apt-get for package installation (Debian/Ubuntu specific)
No Windows-specific or macOS-specific dependencies or tooling
notes: This is a Docker-based Anaconda development container image. The fix updates Pillow from 10.2.0 to 10.3.0 to address a security vulnerability. The project uses conda as the primary package manager with pip for specific Python packages. The build process uses a multi-stage Dockerfile that first builds on the Anaconda base image, then copies the conda environment to a cleaner base image. Testing is done via bash scripts that verify package versions. The platform is Linux (Debian Bullseye) and is fully compatible with Linux x86-64 containers.
